🎥🎬: Batman: Knightfall Part 2 – Knightquest (2026)

With Batman brutally defeated by Bane and left paralysed from the waist down, Gotham City is left without its greatest protector. Unable to continue fighting crime, Bruce Wayne must accept that someone else will have to take up the mantle of the Dark Knight. But finding a replacement capable of defending Gotham proves far more complicated than expected.

Enter Jean-Paul Valley, also known as Azrael, a highly trained and dangerous warrior chosen to become the new Batman. Armed with extraordinary combat skills and a completely different approach to justice, Azrael begins hunting down Gotham’s criminals. However, his increasingly brutal methods raise serious concerns about whether he is actually protecting the city or becoming another threat to it.

As Bruce struggles to recover and reclaim his identity, Gotham discovers that having a new Batman may be more dangerous than having no Batman at all. With Bane’s shadow still hanging over the city, the battle for the soul of the Dark Knight begins.
